notes: The summer session is for high school students ages 14 to 19 who can work legally in the US. You cannot turn 20 before June of the school year. Questions: recruitment@hydesquare.org.
name: Jovenes en Accion (Youth in Action)
what_you_do: Year-round program for grades 8 to 12. Join a dance, music or theatre team rooted in Afro-Latin arts, get mentoring and homework help, and train in civic engagement and youth organizing.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 13 to 19 in 8th grade or high school who live or go to school in Boston.
pay_detail: The summer session is paid; amount not posted. School-year pay is not stated.
deadline_text: Fall application open as of Nov 3, 2026, with no close date posted. Fall session Sept 21 to Dec 5, 2026. Winter session Jan 5 to Mar 13, 2027. Spring session Mar 29 to June 5, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the JEA application on the Join Jovenes en Accion page, in English or Spanish. A parent or guardian signs too. The Enrollment Team then contacts you by text or email.
